title: Sapphire Ops Research
text:
Sapphire Ops Research

notes:
POC notes: customer very cost-conscious but unwilling to accept high latency. Repeated ask: 'we need predictable p95 under committed throughput' — procurement wants clear unit economics. Primary ask is a dedicated pool with deterministic performance, not a best-effort shared endpoint. Ops team prefers a hybrid autoscaler (predictive warm pools + reactive scaling) and explicit cool-downs to avoid oscillation. Security highlighted on-prem option for a subset of regulated data; legal flagged data residency clause. Next ops workshop to finalize warm-pool sizing and failure-mode behavior (how we handle queued requests during scale events). Action items: provide detailed cost model for 12/24 month reserved commitment, updated SLA language for latency guarantees, run a 48h endurance test with synthetic diurnal spikes, confirm HSM/KMS integration pattern. Linked deck and security FAQ uploaded to their Drive; procurement thread awaiting finance sign-off.

requirements_summary:
Workload: public-facing chat assistant + reranking for personalized feeds + nightly batch embeddings
Throughput target: guarantee 500 req/s sustained at 512-token average; burst to 2k req/s for up to 5 minutes
Latency SLO: p95 < 120ms for interactive chat, p99 < 300ms is desired; p95 < 200ms acceptable for reranking
Reserved GPU planning: planning worksheet proposes 8x H100 equivalent for baseline capacity + 2x H100 warm pool nodes
Autoscaling: prefer hybrid policy (predictive warm pool + reactive scale up by queue length and GPU util)
Scale-down: conservative cooldown 10 minutes to avoid flapping; scale-up agressive on sustained queue > 50 requests
Queueing: priority routing per customer route, backpressure on lower-priority batch jobs, SLA-aware admission control
Model preferences: open models primarily (LLAMA2/Meta variants) for cost; fallback to larger proprietary for degrade cases
Security: VPC with private control plane, KMS-backed key management, full audit logs and 7-year retention for flagged transactions

recent_activities:
Load test: 10k requests over 10m window, median latency 85ms, p95 160ms (no warm pool)
Warm pool experiment: adding 2 warm nodes reduced cold-starts by ~90% in spike tests
Security: on-prem checklist in progress; customer needs HSM/KMS integration notes
Pricing: customer prefers committed monthly vs pure usage; asked for 12-month reserved quote
